verses.original: וְעָשָׂה֩ בְצַלְאֵ֨ל וְאָהֳלִיאָ֜ב וְכֹ֣ל׀ אִ֣ישׁ חֲכַם־ לֵ֗ב אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֜ה חָכְמָ֤ה וּתְבוּנָה֙ בָּהֵ֔מָּה לָדַ֣עַת לַעֲשֹׂ֔ת אֶֽת־ כָּל־ מְלֶ֖אכֶת עֲבֹדַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖ה יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śāh ḇə·ṣal·’êl wə·’ā·ho·lî·’āḇ wə·ḵōl ’îš ḥă·ḵam- lêḇ ’ă·šer nā·ṯan Yah·weh ḥāḵ·māh ū·ṯə·ḇū·nāh bā·hêm·māh lā·ḏa·‘aṯ la·‘ă·śōṯ ’eṯ- kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ haq·qō·ḏeš lə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh
verses.literal: So Bezalel Oholiab and every skilled . . . person are to carry out everything commanded by the LORD who has given them skill and ability to know how to perform all the work of constructing the sanctuary
verses.literalPt: Bezalel, e Aoliabe trabalharão, e todo homem hábil, a quem Jeová deu sabedoria e inteligência para saberem fazer toda a obra para o serviço do santuário, conforme tudo o que Jeová tem ordenado.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶל־ בְּצַלְאֵ֘ל וְאֶל־ אָֽהֳלִיאָב֒ וְאֶל֙ כָּל־ אִ֣ישׁ חֲכַם־ לֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה חָכְמָ֖ה בְּלִבּ֑וֹ כֹּ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר נְשָׂא֣וֹ לִבּ֔וֹ לְקָרְבָ֥ה אֶל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֖ה לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת אֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā mō·šeh ’el- bə·ṣal·ʾēl wə·’el- ’ā·ho·lî·’āḇ wə·’el kāl- ’îš ḥă·ḵam- lêḇ ’ă·šer nā·ṯan Yah·weh ḥāḵ·māh bə·lib·bōw kōl ’ă·šer nə·śā·’ōw lib·bōw lə·qā·rə·ḇāh ’el- ham·mə·lā·ḵāh la·‘ă·śōṯ ’ō·ṯāh
verses.literal: Then Moses summoned . . . Bezalel . . . Oholiab . . . and every skilled . . . person whom . . . the LORD had gifted . . . everyone whose heart stirred him to come . . . and do the work
verses.literalPt: Moisés chamou a Bezalel, e a Aoliabe, e a todo homem hábil em cujo coração Jeová tinha posto sabedoria, isto é, a todo homem cujo coração o impeliu a se chegar à obra para fazê-la.

verses.original: וַיִּקְח֞וּ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֵ֤ת כָּל־ הַתְּרוּמָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵבִ֜יאוּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִמְלֶ֛אכֶת עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ לַעֲשֹׂ֣ת אֹתָ֑הּ וְ֠הֵם הֵבִ֨יאוּ אֵלָ֥יו ע֛וֹד נְדָבָ֖ה בַּבֹּ֥קֶר בַּבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ḥū mil·lip̄·nê mō·šeh ’êṯ kāl- hat·tə·rū·māh ’ă·šer hê·ḇî·’ū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lim·le·ḵeṯ ‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ haq·qō·ḏeš la·‘ă·śōṯ ’ō·ṯāh wə·hêm hê·ḇî·’ū ’ê·lāw ‘ō·wḏ nə·ḏā·ḇāh bab·bō·qer bab·bō·qer
verses.literal: They received from Moses all the contributions that the Israelites . . . had brought to carry out the service of constructing the sanctuary Meanwhile, the people continued to bring . . . . . . freewill offerings morning after morning
verses.literalPt: Estes receberam de Moisés a oferta toda que os filhos de Israel tinham trazido para a obra do serviço do santuário, a fim de fazê-la. Ainda todos os dias pela manhã, trazia-lhe o povo ofertas voluntárias.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ כָּל־ הַ֣חֲכָמִ֔ים הָעֹשִׂ֕ים אֵ֖ת כָּל־ מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ אִֽישׁ־ אִ֥ישׁ מִמְּלַאכְתּ֖וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִֽׂים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū kāl- ha·ḥă·ḵā·mîm hā·‘ō·śîm ’êṯ kāl- mə·le·ḵeṯ haq·qō·ḏeš ’îš- ’îš mim·mə·laḵ·tōw ’ă·šer- hêm·māh ‘ō·śîm
verses.literal: so that all the skilled craftsmen who were doing all the work on the sanctuary left - their work - . . .
verses.literalPt: Deixando cada um a sua obra que fazia, vieram todos os homens sábios que se ocupavam em toda a obra do santuário

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה לֵּאמֹ֔ר מַרְבִּ֥ים הָעָ֖ם לְהָבִ֑יא מִדֵּ֤י הָֽעֲבֹדָה֙ לַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲשֹׂ֥ת אֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr mar·bîm hā·‘ām lə·hā·ḇî mid·dê hā·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh lam·mə·lā·ḵāh ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh la·‘ă·śōṯ ’ō·ṯāh
verses.literal: and said to Moses . . . The people are bringing more than enough for doing the work the LORD has commanded us to do
verses.literalPt: e disseram a Moisés: O povo traz muito mais do que é necessário para o serviço da obra que Jeová ordenou se fizesse.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיַּעֲבִ֨ירוּ ק֥וֹל בַּֽמַּחֲנֶה֮ לֵאמֹר֒ אִ֣ישׁ וְאִשָּׁ֗ה אַל־ יַעֲשׂוּ־ ע֛וֹד מְלָאכָ֖ה לִתְרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וַיִּכָּלֵ֥א הָעָ֖ם מֵהָבִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw mō·šeh way·ya·‘ă·ḇî·rū qō·wl bam·ma·ḥă·neh lê·mōr ’îš wə·’iš·šāh ’al- ya·‘ă·śū- ‘ō·wḏ mə·lā·ḵāh liṯ·rū·maṯ haq·qō·ḏeš way·yik·kā·lê hā·‘ām mê·hā·ḇî
verses.literal: After Moses had given an order they sent a proclamation throughout the camp . . . No man or woman should make anything else as an offering for the sanctuary So the people were restrained from bringing more
verses.literalPt: Deu ordem, pois, Moisés (e fizeram que a ordem fosse proclamada por todo o arraial), dizendo: Nenhum homem, nem mulher faça mais obra alguma para a oferta do santuário. Assim, o povo foi proibido de trazer mais.

verses.original: וְהַמְּלָאכָ֗ה הָיְתָ֥ה דַיָּ֛ם לְכָל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֖ה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אֹתָ֑הּ וְהוֹתֵֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·mə·lā·ḵāh hā·yə·ṯāh ḏay·yām lə·ḵāl ham·mə·lā·ḵāh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’ō·ṯāh wə·hō·w·ṯêr
verses.literal: since what they already had was more than enough to perform all . . . the work
verses.literalPt: Pois a matéria que tinham era suficiente para fazer toda a obra e ainda sobejava.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֨וּ כָל־ חֲכַם־ לֵ֜ב בְּעֹשֵׂ֧י הַמְּלָאכָ֛ה אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן עֶ֣שֶׂר יְרִיעֹ֑ת שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י כְּרֻבִ֛ים מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ḵāl ḥă·ḵam- lêḇ bə·‘ō·śê ham·mə·lā·ḵāh ’eṯ- ham·miš·kān ‘e·śer yə·rî·‘ōṯ šêš mā·šə·zār ū·ṯə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî kə·ru·ḇîm ma·‘ă·śêh ḥō·šêḇ ‘ā·śāh ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: All the skilled craftsmen . . . among the workmen . . . made the ten curtains for the tabernacle They were made of finely spun linen as well as blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . with cherubim skillfully worked into them
verses.literalPt: Todo homem hábil, entre os que faziam a obra, construiu o tabernáculo com dez cortinas; fê-las de linho fino retorcido, estofo azul, púrpura e escarlata, com querubins que são obra de desenhista.

verses.original: אֹ֜רֶךְ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָֽאַחַ֗ת שְׁמֹנֶ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֙חַב֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה הַיְרִיעָ֖ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לְכָל־ הַיְרִיעֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·reḵ hay·rî·‘āh hā·’a·ḥaṯ šə·mō·neh wə·‘eś·rîm bā·’am·māh wə·rō·ḥaḇ ’ar·ba‘ bā·’am·māh hay·rî·‘āh hā·’e·ḥāṯ mid·dāh ’a·ḥaṯ lə·ḵāl hay·rî·‘ōṯ
verses.literal: Each curtain was twenty-eight cubits long - and four cubits wide all the curtains were the same size
verses.literalPt: O comprimento de cada cortina era de vinte e oito cúbitos, e a largura de cada cortina, de quatro cúbitos; todas as cortinas eram de uma mesma medida.

verses.original: וַיְחַבֵּר֙ אֶת־ חֲמֵ֣שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֔ת אַחַ֖ת אֶל־ אֶחָ֑ת וְחָמֵ֤שׁ יְרִיעֹת֙ חִבַּ֔ר אַחַ֖ת אֶל־ אֶחָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥab·bêr ’eṯ- ḥă·mêš hay·rî·‘ōṯ ’a·ḥaṯ ’el- ’e·ḥāṯ wə·ḥā·mêš yə·rî·‘ōṯ ḥib·bar ’a·ḥaṯ ’el- ’e·ḥāṯ
verses.literal: And he joined five of the curtains together . . . . . . and the other five he joined . . . as well . . .
verses.literalPt: Ajuntou cinco cortinas uma com outra; e as outras cinco, da mesma maneira.

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ לֻֽלְאֹ֣ת תְּכֵ֗לֶת עַ֣ל שְׂפַ֤ת הַיְרִיעָה֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת מִקָּצָ֖ה בַּמַּחְבָּ֑רֶת כֵּ֤ן עָשָׂה֙ בִּשְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַקִּ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה בַּמַּחְבֶּ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś lul·’ōṯ tə·ḵê·leṯ ‘al śə·p̄aṯ hay·rî·‘āh hā·’e·ḥāṯ miq·qā·ṣāh bam·maḥ·bā·reṯ kên ‘ā·śāh biś·p̄aṯ hay·rî·‘āh haq·qî·ṣō·w·nāh bam·maḥ·be·reṯ haš·šê·nîṯ
verses.literal: He made loops of blue material on the edge of the end curtain in the first set and also . . . . . . on the end curtain in the second set
verses.literalPt: Fez laçadas de estofo azul na orla da cortina extrema do primeiro agrupamento; da mesma maneira fez na orla da cortina extrema do segundo agrupamento.

verses.original: חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻלָאֹ֗ת עָשָׂה֮ בַּיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאֶחָת֒ וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻלָאֹ֗ת עָשָׂה֙ בִּקְצֵ֣ה הַיְרִיעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בַּמַּחְבֶּ֣רֶת הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית מַקְבִּילֹת֙ הַלֻּ֣לָאֹ֔ת אַחַ֖ת אֶל־ אֶחָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·miš·šîm lu·lā·’ōṯ ‘ā·śāh bay·rî·‘āh hā·’e·ḥāṯ wa·ḥă·miš·šîm lu·lā·’ōṯ ‘ā·śāh biq·ṣêh hay·rî·‘āh ’ă·šer bam·maḥ·be·reṯ haš·šê·nîṯ maq·bî·lōṯ hal·lu·lā·’ōṯ ’a·ḥaṯ ’el- ’e·ḥāṯ
verses.literal: He made fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops . . . on the end curtain of the second set so that the loops lined up opposite one another
verses.literalPt: Cinquenta laçadas fez numa cortina, e cinquenta laçadas, na cortina extrema do segundo agrupamento; as laçadas eram contrapostas uma a outra.

verses.original: וַיַּ֕עַשׂ חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים קַרְסֵ֣י זָהָ֑ב וַיְחַבֵּ֨ר אֶת־ הַיְרִעֹ֜ת אַחַ֤ת אֶל־ אַחַת֙ בַּקְּרָסִ֔ים וַֽיְהִ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן אֶחָֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ḥă·miš·šîm qar·sê zā·hāḇ way·ḥab·bêr ’eṯ- hay·ri·‘ōṯ ’a·ḥaṯ ’el- ’a·ḥaṯ baq·qə·rā·sîm way·hî ham·miš·kān ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: He also made fifty gold clasps to join the curtains together . . . . . . . . . so that the tabernacle was a unit
verses.literalPt: Fez cinquenta colchetes do ouro e, com os colchetes, prendeu as cortinas uma a outra; assim, o tabernáculo veio a ser um todo.

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ יְרִיעֹ֣ת עִזִּ֔ים לְאֹ֖הֶל עַל־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עַשְׁתֵּֽי־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה יְרִיעֹ֖ת עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś yə·rî·‘ōṯ ‘iz·zîm lə·’ō·hel ‘al- ham·miš·kān ‘aš·tê- ‘eś·rêh yə·rî·‘ōṯ ‘ā·śāh ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: He then made curtains of goat hair for the tent over the tabernacle eleven . . . curtains in all
verses.literalPt: Fez também de pelos de cabras cortinas para servir de tenda sobre o tabernáculo; onze cortinas fez.

verses.original: אֹ֜רֶךְ הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאַחַ֗ת שְׁלֹשִׁים֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְאַרְבַּ֣ע אַמּ֔וֹת רֹ֖חַב הַיְרִיעָ֣ה הָאֶחָ֑ת מִדָּ֣ה אַחַ֔ת לְעַשְׁתֵּ֥י עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה יְרִיעֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·reḵ hay·rî·‘āh hā·’a·ḥaṯ šə·lō·šîm bā·’am·māh wə·’ar·ba‘ ’am·mō·wṯ rō·ḥaḇ hay·rî·‘āh hā·’e·ḥāṯ mid·dāh ’a·ḥaṯ lə·‘aš·tê ‘eś·rêh yə·rî·‘ōṯ
verses.literal: Each of the eleven . . . curtains was the same size - thirty cubits long and four cubits wide
verses.literalPt: O comprimento de cada cortina era de trinta cúbitos, e a largura de cada cortina, de quatro cúbitos; as onze cortinas tinham uma mesma medida.

verses.original: וַיְחַבֵּ֛ר אֶת־ חֲמֵ֥שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֖ת לְבָ֑ד וְאֶת־ שֵׁ֥שׁ הַיְרִיעֹ֖ת לְבָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥab·bêr ’eṯ- ḥă·mêš hay·rî·‘ōṯ lə·ḇāḏ wə·’eṯ- šêš hay·rî·‘ōṯ lə·ḇāḏ
verses.literal: He joined five of the curtains into one set and the other six into another
verses.literalPt: Ajuntou à parte cinco cortinas entre si e da mesma maneira, seis cortinas.

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ לֻֽלָאֹ֣ת חֲמִשִּׁ֗ים עַ֚ל שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַקִּיצֹנָ֖ה בַּמַּחְבָּ֑רֶת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים לֻלָאֹ֗ת עָשָׂה֙ עַל־ שְׂפַ֣ת הַיְרִיעָ֔ה הַחֹבֶ֖רֶת הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś lu·lā·’ōṯ ḥă·miš·šîm ‘al śə·p̄aṯ hay·rî·‘āh haq·qî·ṣō·nāh bam·maḥ·bā·reṯ wa·ḥă·miš·šîm lu·lā·’ōṯ ‘ā·śāh ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ hay·rî·‘āh ha·ḥō·ḇe·reṯ haš·šê·nîṯ
verses.literal: He made fifty loops along the edge of the end curtain in the first set and fifty loops . . . along the edge of the corresponding curtain in the second set
verses.literalPt: Fez cinquenta laçadas na orla da cortina extrema do primeiro agrupamento e cinquenta laçadas na orla da cortina extrema do segundo agrupamento.

verses.original: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ קַרְסֵ֥י נְחֹ֖שֶׁת חֲמִשִּׁ֑ים לְחַבֵּ֥ר אֶת־ הָאֹ֖הֶל לִֽהְיֹ֥ת אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś qar·sê nə·ḥō·šeṯ ḥă·miš·šîm lə·ḥab·bêr ’eṯ- hā·’ō·hel lih·yōṯ ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: He also made fifty bronze clasps to join the tent . . . together as a unit
verses.literalPt: Fez cinquenta colchetes de cobre para ajuntar a tenda, a fim de que viesse a ser um todo.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ מִכְסֶה֙ לָאֹ֔הֶל עֹרֹ֥ת אֵלִ֖ים מְאָדָּמִ֑ים וּמִכְסֵ֛ה עֹרֹ֥ת תְּחָשִׁ֖ים מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś miḵ·seh lā·’ō·hel ‘ō·rōṯ ’ê·lîm mə·’ād·dā·mîm ū·miḵ·sêh ‘ō·rōṯ tə·ḥā·šîm mil·mā·‘ə·lāh
verses.literal: Additionally, he made for the tent a covering of ram skins dyed red and over that a covering of fine leather
verses.literalPt: Fez de peles de carneiros, tintas de vermelho, uma coberta para a tenda, e por cima destas, uma coberta de peles de animais marinhos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־ הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים עֹמְדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- haq·qə·rā·šîm lam·miš·kān ‘ă·ṣê šiṭ·ṭîm ‘ō·mə·ḏîm
verses.literal: Next, he constructed upright frames of acacia wood for the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: Fez também de madeira de acácia as peças para o tabernáculo, que eram colocadas verticalmente.

verses.original: עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמֹּ֖ות אֹ֣רֶךְ הַקָּ֑רֶשׁ וְאַמָּה֙ וַחֲצִ֣י הָֽאַמָּ֔ה רֹ֖חַב הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ‘e·śer ʾam·mō·wṯ ’ō·reḵ haq·qā·reš wə·’am·māh wa·ḥă·ṣî hā·’am·māh rō·ḥaḇ haq·qe·reš hā·’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: Each frame was ten cubits long and a cubit and a half . . . wide . . .
verses.literalPt: De dez cúbitos era o comprimento de uma peça, e cada uma tinha um cúbito e meio de largura.

verses.original: שְׁתֵּ֣י יָדֹ֗ת לַקֶּ֙רֶשׁ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד מְשֻׁלָּבֹ֔ת אַחַ֖ת אֶל־ אֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֣ן עָשָׂ֔ה לְכֹ֖ל קַרְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: šə·tê yā·ḏōṯ laq·qe·reš hā·’e·ḥāḏ mə·šul·lā·ḇōṯ ’a·ḥaṯ ’el- ’e·ḥāṯ kên ‘ā·śāh lə·ḵōl qar·šê ham·miš·kān
verses.literal: Two tenons were connected to each other for each frame He made all the frames of the tabernacle in this way
verses.literalPt: Em cada peça havia duas couceiras unidas uma a outra; assim fez com todas as peças do tabernáculo.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־ הַקְּרָשִׁ֖ים לַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עֶשְׂרִ֣ים קְרָשִׁ֔ים לִפְאַ֖ת נֶ֥גֶב תֵּימָֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- haq·qə·rā·šîm lam·miš·kān ‘eś·rîm qə·rā·šîm lip̄·’aṯ ne·ḡeḇ tê·mā·nāh
verses.literal: He constructed - twenty frames for the south . . . side of the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: Fez as peças para o tabernáculo: vinte peças para o lado meridional, que olha para o sul.

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אַדְנֵי־ כֶ֔סֶף עָשָׂ֕ה תַּ֖חַת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים הַקְּרָשִׁ֑ים שְׁנֵ֨י אֲדָנִ֜ים תַּֽחַת־ הַקֶּ֤רֶשׁ הָאֶחָד֙ לִשְׁתֵּ֣י יְדֹתָ֔יו וּשְׁנֵ֧י אֲדָנִ֛ים תַּֽחַת־ הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֖ד לִשְׁתֵּ֥י יְדֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ar·bā·‘îm ’aḏ·nê- ḵe·sep̄ ‘ā·śāh ta·ḥaṯ ‘eś·rîm haq·qə·rā·šîm šə·nê ’ă·ḏā·nîm ta·ḥaṯ- haq·qe·reš hā·’e·ḥāḏ liš·tê yə·ḏō·ṯāw ū·šə·nê ’ă·ḏā·nîm ta·ḥaṯ- haq·qe·reš hā·’e·ḥāḏ liš·tê yə·ḏō·ṯāw
verses.literal: with forty silver bases to put under the twenty frames two bases for each frame one - - under each tenon
verses.literalPt: Fez quarenta bases de prata para se pôr debaixo das vinte peças: duas bases debaixo de uma peça, de maneira que correspondessem às duas couceiras dela, igualmente duas bases debaixo de outra peça.

verses.original: וּלְצֶ֧לַע הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית לִפְאַ֣ת צָפ֑וֹן עָשָׂ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים קְרָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ṣe·la‘ ham·miš·kān haš·šê·nîṯ lip̄·’aṯ ṣā·p̄ō·wn ‘ā·śāh ‘eś·rîm qə·rā·šîm
verses.literal: For the second side of the tabernacle the north side he made twenty frames
verses.literalPt: Para o segundo lado do tabernáculo, da banda do norte, fez vinte peças

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים אַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֗ים תַּ֚חַת הַקֶּ֣רֶשׁ הָאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ar·bā·‘îm ’aḏ·nê·hem kā·sep̄ šə·nê ’ă·ḏā·nîm ta·ḥaṯ haq·qe·reš hā·’e·ḥāḏ ū·šə·nê ’ă·ḏā·nîm ta·ḥaṯ haq·qe·reš hā·’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: and forty silver bases two bases under - - each frame
verses.literalPt: e as suas quarenta bases de prata; duas bases debaixo de uma peça e duas bases debaixo de outra peça.

verses.original: וּֽלְיַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יָ֑מָּה עָשָׂ֖ה שִׁשָּׁ֥ה קְרָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·yar·kə·ṯê ham·miš·kān yām·māh ‘ā·śāh šiš·šāh qə·rā·šîm
verses.literal: He made six frames for the rear of the tabernacle the west side
verses.literalPt: Para o lado posterior do tabernáculo, que olha para o ocidente, fez seis peças.

verses.original: וּשְׁנֵ֤י קְרָשִׁים֙ עָשָׂ֔ה לִמְקֻצְעֹ֖ת הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן בַּיַּרְכָתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·nê qə·rā·šîm ‘ā·śāh lim·quṣ·‘ōṯ ham·miš·kān bay·yar·ḵā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: and two frames for the two back corners of the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: Fez também duas peças para os cantos do tabernáculo na parte posterior.

verses.original: וְהָי֣וּ תוֹאֲמִם֮ מִלְּמַטָּה֒ וְיַחְדָּ֗ו יִהְי֤וּ תַמִּים֙ אֶל־ רֹאשׁ֔וֹ אֶל־ הַטַּבַּ֖עַת הָאֶחָ֑ת כֵּ֚ן עָשָׂ֣ה לִשְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם לִשְׁנֵ֖י הַמִּקְצֹעֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū ṯō·w·’ă·mim mil·lə·maṭ·ṭāh wə·yaḥ·dāw yih·yū ṯam·mîm ’el- rō·šōw ’el- haṭ·ṭab·ba·‘aṯ hā·’e·ḥāṯ kên ‘ā·śāh liš·nê·hem liš·nê ham·miq·ṣō·‘ōṯ
verses.literal: coupled together from bottom . . . . . . . . . to top and fitted into a single ring He made both corners in this way
verses.literalPt: Por baixo, eram reforçadas uma pela outra; e, do mesmo modo, em cima, até a primeira argola; assim fez com as duas peças nos dois cantos.

verses.original: וְהָיוּ֙ שְׁמֹנָ֣ה קְרָשִׁ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֣ם כֶּ֔סֶף שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֲדָנִ֑ים שְׁנֵ֤י אֲדָנִים֙ שְׁנֵ֣י אֲדָנִ֔ים תַּ֖חַת הַקֶּ֥רֶשׁ הָאֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū šə·mō·nāh qə·rā·šîm wə·’aḏ·nê·hem ke·sep̄ šiš·šāh ‘ā·śār ’ă·ḏā·nîm šə·nê ’ă·ḏā·nîm šə·nê ’ă·ḏā·nîm ta·ḥaṯ haq·qe·reš hā·’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: So there were eight frames and sixteen . . . silver bases two . . . . . . . . . under each frame
verses.literalPt: Assim, havia oito peças com as suas bases de prata, dezesseis bases; duas bases debaixo de cada peça.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ בְּרִיחֵ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חֲמִשָּׁ֕ה לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הָאֶחָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś bə·rî·ḥê ‘ă·ṣê šiṭ·ṭîm ḥă·miš·šāh lə·qar·šê ṣe·la‘- ham·miš·kān hā·’e·ḥāṯ
verses.literal: He also made five crossbars of acacia wood for the frames on one side of the tabernacle
verses.literalPt: Também de madeira de acácia fez travessas; cinco para as peças dum lado do tabernáculo,

verses.original: וַחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה בְרִיחִ֔ם לְקַרְשֵׁ֥י צֶֽלַע־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית וַחֲמִשָּׁ֤ה בְרִיחִם֙ לְקַרְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן לַיַּרְכָתַ֖יִם יָֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·ḥă·miš·šāh ḇə·rî·ḥim lə·qar·šê ṣe·la‘- ham·miš·kān haš·šê·nîṯ wa·ḥă·miš·šāh ḇə·rî·ḥim lə·qar·šê ham·miš·kān lay·yar·ḵā·ṯa·yim yām·māh
verses.literal: five for those on the other side and five for those on the rear side of the tabernacle to the west
verses.literalPt: cinco para as peças do outro lado do tabernáculo e cinco para as peças do tabernáculo ao lado posterior, que olha o ocidente.

verses.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־ הַבְּרִ֣יחַ הַתִּיכֹ֑ן לִבְרֹ֙חַ֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַקְּרָשִׁ֔ים מִן־ הַקָּצֶ֖ה אֶל־ הַקָּצֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- hab·bə·rî·aḥ hat·tî·ḵōn liḇ·rō·aḥ bə·ṯō·wḵ haq·qə·rā·šîm min- haq·qā·ṣeh ’el- haq·qā·ṣeh
verses.literal: He made the central crossbar to run through the center of the frames from one end to the other
verses.literalPt: Fez a travessa do meio passar ao meio das peças de uma extremidade à outra.

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־ הַקְּרָשִׁ֞ים צִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֗ב וְאֶת־ טַבְּעֹתָם֙ עָשָׂ֣ה זָהָ֔ב בָּתִּ֖ים לַבְּרִיחִ֑ם וַיְצַ֥ף אֶת־ הַבְּרִיחִ֖ם זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- haq·qə·rā·šîm ṣip·pāh zā·hāḇ wə·’eṯ- ṭab·bə·‘ō·ṯām ‘ā·śāh zā·hāḇ bāt·tîm lab·bə·rî·ḥim way·ṣap̄ ’eṯ- hab·bə·rî·ḥim zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: And he overlaid the frames with gold and made gold rings to hold the crossbars He also overlaid the crossbars with gold
verses.literalPt: Cobriu de ouro as peças, e de ouro fez as suas argolas pelas quais passaram as travessas, e cobriu também de ouro as travessas.

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ אֶת־ הַפָּרֹ֔כֶת תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֛ב עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖הּ כְּרֻבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’eṯ- hap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî wə·šêš mā·šə·zār ma·‘ă·śêh ḥō·šêḇ ‘ā·śāh ’ō·ṯāh kə·ru·ḇîm
verses.literal: Next, he made the veil of blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . and finely spun linen - with cherubim skillfully worked into it
verses.literalPt: Fez também o véu de estofo azul, púrpura, escarlata e linho fino retorcido; com querubins, obra de desenhista, o fez.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ לָ֗הּ אַרְבָּעָה֙ עַמּוּדֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וַיְצַפֵּ֣ם זָהָ֔ב וָוֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וַיִּצֹ֣ק לָהֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעָ֖ה אַדְנֵי־ כָֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś lāh ’ar·bā·‘āh ‘am·mū·ḏê šiṭ·ṭîm way·ṣap·pêm zā·hāḇ wā·wê·hem zā·hāḇ way·yi·ṣōq lā·hem ’ar·bā·‘āh ’aḏ·nê- ḵā·sep̄
verses.literal: He also made four posts of acacia wood for it and overlaid them with gold along with gold hooks and he cast four silver bases for the posts
verses.literalPt: Suspendeu o véu sobre quatro colunas de madeira de acácia e cobriu-as de ouro; os seus ganchos eram de ouro, e fundiu de prata as suas quatro bases.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ מָסָךְ֙ לְפֶ֣תַח הָאֹ֔הֶל תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś mā·sāḵ lə·p̄e·ṯaḥ hā·’ō·hel tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî wə·šêš mā·šə·zār ma·‘ă·śêh rō·qêm
verses.literal: For the entrance to the tent he made a curtain embroidered with blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . and finely spun . . . linen
verses.literalPt: Também para a porta da tenda fez um anteparo de estofo azul, púrpura, escarlata e linho fino retorcido, obra de bordador,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ עַמּוּדָ֤יו חֲמִשָּׁה֙ וְאֶת־ וָ֣וֵיהֶ֔ם וְצִפָּ֧ה רָאשֵׁיהֶ֛ם וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם זָהָ֑ב וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֥ם חֲמִשָּׁ֖ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ‘am·mū·ḏāw ḥă·miš·šāh wə·’eṯ- wā·wê·hem wə·ṣip·pāh rā·šê·hem wa·ḥă·šu·qê·hem zā·hāḇ wə·’aḏ·nê·hem ḥă·miš·šāh nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: together with five posts and their hooks He overlaid the tops of the posts and their bands with gold and their five bases were bronze
verses.literalPt: e as suas cinco colunas e os seus ganchos. De ouro cobriu os seus capitéis e as suas vergas; e as suas cinco bases eram de cobre.
